The labels are horizontally centered within compact content-width chips. No blank marker gutter is visible before a neutral label; adjacent chips do not overlap.

The original reference shows the same centered neutral outline treatment at twice the native scale. Its twelve-tag content differs from this nine-tag catalog, so the reference's eight/four row split is not imposed on this image.
The filter trigger is visibly neutral without a count badge. The disabled follow/rating sort controls are visibly gray and agree with the static enabled flags.
